description: This file defines an Angular component named NoteEditorComponent used for editing notes, including handling input properties, output events, and change detection for note data.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component facilitating note editing, handling input note data, and emitting save and delete events.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates the component's title and content when the input note changes.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Emits the save event with current title and content when the save button is triggered.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Emits the delete event when the delete action is triggered.

ctags.name: save
ctags.pattern: /^  @Output() save = new EventEmitter<{ title: string; content: string }>();$/

fields.name: @Output() save = new EventEmitter<{ title: string; content: string }>();
